options.title: Krispy Kreme Got Into McDonald's. Why Did It End?
options.first_line: Krispy Kreme got its doughnuts into McDonald's, and then the two called the whole deal off.
options.first_frame: A Krispy Kreme neon sign pushes in, then whips to the golden arches as a red stamp slams OFF.

options.title: Why Did Krispy Kreme and McDonald's Break Up?
options.first_line: McDonald's and Krispy Kreme were going to put glazed doughnuts in every McDonald's in America, then they broke up.
options.first_frame: The golden arches against a blue sky, a box of glazed Krispy Kreme doughnuts punching in beside them.

options.title: Krispy Kreme Was Promised {fact2} McDonald's
options.first_line: Krispy Kreme was meant to be in every one of the {fact2} McDonald's in America.
options.first_frame: A McDonald's restaurant at the roadside with the figure slamming in over its roof, then a Krispy Kreme box.

why: It names both brands and asks one clear question a stranger wants answered (why did a plan for glazed doughnuts in every McDonald's in America fall apart?), puts the doughnut box you have bought in the first frame, and holds the reason back, while A's title is muddier and C's figure gives scale without a question.
